# Introduction
This notebook document the loading and preprocess of OME-TIFF images for alignement.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import spatialdata_io
import os

import xenium_align as xa
```

# --- LOAD IMAGES ---
## Post xenium - H&E
The first step is to load the images and preprocess them 
```{python Load }
# HE
HE_IMG_PATH = Path("../Sample_HE/HE_cellvit/ADK_explorer.ome.tif")
# XENIUM
XE_DIR = Path("../Sample_HE/output_XE_colon")
XE_IMG_PATH = xa.data.get_xenium_image_paths(XE_DIR)

# Output directory
output_dir = Path("./Xenium_HE_registration_results")
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


# --- SOURCE (H&E) ---
# Load hematoxylin
raw_he, meta_he = xa.data.load_downsampled_image(HE_IMG_PATH)

plt.figure(figsize=(15, 15))
plt.imshow(raw_he)
plt.axis('off')
plt.close()

he_proc = xa.data.prepare_he(raw_he)

plt.figure(figsize=(15, 15))
plt.imshow(he_proc)
plt.axis('off')
plt.close()




# --- TARGET (Xenium) ---
# Load DAPI
XE_IMG_PATH_DAPI = XE_IMG_PATH.pop("DAPI")
dapi, meta_xe = xa.data.load_downsampled_image(XE_IMG_PATH_DAPI)
channels_raw = {"DAPI": dapi}
offset_x, offset_y = xa.data.calculate_pyramidal_offset(XE_IMG_PATH_DAPI, meta_xe)
# Load other channels
channels_raw.update({
    name: xa.data.load_downsampled_image(path)[0] 
    for name, path in XE_IMG_PATH.items()
})
channels_proc, combos = xa.data.prepare_xe_generate_combination(channels_raw)

# Define the composite image to match
combo_name = 'DAPI_ATP1A'
channels_to_combine = combos[combo_name]
xe_proc = xa.data.combine_xenium_channels(channels_proc, channels_to_combine)

plt.figure(figsize=(15, 15))
plt.imshow(xe_proc)
plt.axis('off')
plt.close()
```


## Post xenium - multi-IF
```{python Load }
# Base directory
HOME = Path("../Sample_mIF/")
# MIF
MIF_IMG_PATH = Path("../Sample_mIF/xenium_2.ome.tif")
# XENIUM DAPI
XE_IMG_PATH_DAPI = Path("../Sample_mIF/output_XE_neuroblastome/morphology_focus/morphology_focus_0000.ome.tif")

# Output directory
output_dir = Path("./Xenium_HE_registration_results")
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


# --- SOURCE (mIF) ---
# Load hematoxylin
raw_mif, meta_mif = xa.data.load_downsampled_image(MIF_IMG_PATH)

plt.figure(figsize=(15, 15))
plt.imshow(raw_mif)
plt.axis('off')
plt.close()

mif_proc = xa.data.prepare_mif(raw_mif)

plt.figure(figsize=(15, 15))
plt.imshow(mif_proc)
plt.axis('off')
plt.close()

# --- TARGET (Xenium) ---
# Load DAPI
dapi, meta_xe = xa.data.load_downsampled_image(XE_IMG_PATH_DAPI)
offset_x, offset_y = xa.data.calculate_pyramidal_offset(XE_IMG_PATH_DAPI, meta_xe)
xe_proc = xa.data.prepare_xe(dapi)

plt.figure(figsize=(15, 15))
plt.imshow(xe_proc)
plt.axis('off')
plt.close()
```


# --- REGISTRATION ---
```{python Registration}
combo_dir = os.path.join(output_dir, combo_name)
if not os.path.exists(combo_dir): os.makedirs(combo_dir)


fixed = xa.data.get_sitk_image(he_proc, meta_he)
moving = xa.data.get_sitk_image(xe_proc, meta_xe)
# Visualize initial overlap
xa.plot.single_overlay(fixed, moving, combo_dir, "initial.png")
# Run registration
moving_rigid, tx_rigid, moving_bspline, tx_bspline = xa.module.run_registration(fixed, moving, combo_dir)
# Visualize results
xa.plot.registration_summary(fixed, moving, moving_rigid, moving_bspline, combo_dir)
xa.plot.local_deformations(fixed, tx_bspline, combo_dir)
```

# --- LOAD CELLS ---
Load cells as spatial object
## Load CellViT++ Segmentations
```{python}
# Generate SpatialData object from cellvit output ".geojson.snappy"
input_cellvit_snappy = "../Sample_HE/HE_cellvit/cells.geojson.snappy"
cellvit_cells_he = xa.data.read_cellvit(input_cellvit_snappy)

# Optional: Export segmentations to pixel as GeoJSON (e.g., for QuPath import)
# cellvit_cells_he = xa.data.read_cellvit(input_cellvit_snappy, output_geojson="cellvit_cells_he.geojson")
```
## Load Xenium Segmentations
```{python}
# Generate SpatialData object from Xenium output
xenium_cells_xe = spatialdata_io.xenium(XE_DIR)

# Optional: Export segmentations to pixel as GeoJSON (e.g., for QuPath import)
# Default exports both cells and nucleus boudaries. Toggle flags to select (export_cells=False or export_nucleus=False)
# xa.data.export_xenium_to_pixel_geojson(XE_DIR, meta_xe, output_dir)
```

Transform cells from spatial data, .geojson or gdf

cellvit_cells_transformed_xe = apply_sitk_transform(cellvit_cells_he, combo_dir, meta_he, meta_xe, offset_x = offset_x, offset_y = offset_y, sdata_shapes_key = 'cells')
